name: Feishu messages
author: Mika plugin example
description: The Feishu messaging skill plus a tool that sends messages through a custom bot webhook; needs the P1b tool hookup.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send a text message through a Feishu custom bot webhook

webhook.description: Webhook URL of a Feishu custom bot, such as https://open.feishu.cn/open-apis/bot/v2/hook/...

text.description: Text to send, at most 20000 characters

secret.description: Optional: the secret when the bot has signature verification enabled
